name: footer
title: Footer
purpose: Close an application with brand context, grouped links, and optional contact or social information.
accessibility: Uses a semantic footer and labeled navigation landmark with native links.
External social links receive accessible names and noreferrer protection.
The linked brand image or text title requires a meaningful accessible name.
commonMistakes: Assuming the navigation always has exactly three sections.
Publishing placeholder contact information as real data.
Using decorative icon-only links without accessible names.

examples.title: Multiple sections
examples.description: Footer navigation expands to the number of typed sections provided.
examples.source:
<script setup lang="ts">
import Footer from "@/components/ui/Footer.vue";
const logo = { title: "BALSA UI", alt: "Balsa UI placeholder", href: "/" };
const sections = [
  {
    "title": "Section placeholder 01",
    "links": [
      {
        "title": "Link placeholder 01",
        "link": "#link-placeholder-01"
      },
      {
        "title": "Link placeholder 02",
        "link": "#link-placeholder-02"
      }
    ]
  },
  {
    "title": "Section placeholder 02",
    "links": [
      {
        "title": "Link placeholder 03",
        "link": "#link-placeholder-03"
      },
      {
        "title": "Link placeholder 04",
        "link": "#link-placeholder-04"
      }
    ]
  }
];
</script>

<template>
  <Footer :legal-logo="logo" description="Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit." :sections="sections" copyright="Placeholder copyright" legal-text="Legal text placeholder." />
</template>
